prompt:
Use the attached clay render as the exact blueprint. Keep every wall, opening, window, cornice, skirting, floor and ceiling line, the camera height, lens and angle, and the position, size and angle of every furniture piece and built-in exactly as in the clay. Move, resize, add or remove nothing. Each placeholder shape in the clay marks one product listed below; render it there at the stated size. Only turn the clay into real materials and light. The other attached images are close-ups of the exact products: match their form, colour and texture. Positions are fractions of frame width (x) and height (y) from the top-left.

1. PHOTO. Top Scandinavian interiors magazine: the front of a Nordic kitchen, 3 pm mid-winter, 24 mm shift lens at 1.1 m, level, straight verticals, all sharp. Two heroes on the thirds: the plastered hood left, the glowing oak coffee niche right. The same room, products and light as reference 1, turned 35 degrees right.

2. LIGHT. The window is out of frame left, no sun: soft daylight enters from the left and falls off smoothly half a stop toward the west wall, which sits in soft shade. Exposed for white: the upstand and wall at the left clean white. Every object: a lit left face, a shadow side a stop darker, dense contact shadows; bench and table end cast soft shadows right. Ceiling corner a touch darker. Real contrast, never milky. 4600 K: whites white, never cream, pink or grey. Practicals 2700 K, low, shadowless: hidden LED strips under both shelves wash the limestone upstand in soft gradients; the niche LED warms its oak lining, one step warmer than the wall, never brighter.

3. GEOMETRY AND MATERIALS. Exactly the clay's heights: counter top edge at y 0.49, shelf undersides and hood bottom at y 0.31, niche y 0.29-0.49. Matte mineral paint #F4F1EC. Wide oiled white-oak planks, pale honey #D6BF9E. Flat handleless warm-white matte fronts, honed light limestone counter and upstand, flush matte hob, matte black tap and oven bar; the hood in warm-white lime plaster, its trowelled texture caught by the side light. Shelves, niche lining, table, bench: oiled oak #C8A27A, satin sheen.

4. PRODUCTS, one per line, each on its clay placeholder:
a. BENCH PAD, cut by the left edge: off-white linen-look cushion, 3 cm thin.
b. RUG under the table end: flat hand-woven off-white wool, visible loom slub.
c. PRINT on the left shelf, x 0.10-0.16, y 0.21-0.30: 30 x 40, taupe block and black line on white, thin black frame, leaning; nothing else on that shelf.
d. MILLS right of the hob, x 0.40-0.42: two light-oak pepper mills, each half the tap's height.
e. BOWL, x 0.45-0.49: 21 cm warm-white matte bowl, low, three russet pears.
f. PAPER TOWEL STAND, x 0.54-0.56, y 0.41-0.49: 31 cm solid natural-wood slotted column stand, plain warm-white roll.
g. PLATES on the right shelf, x 0.42-0.47: a low stack of four matte grey-sand plates.
h. MUGS, x 0.47-0.52: three small sandy stoneware mugs, cream rims.
i. JARS in the niche, x 0.64-0.71, y 0.42-0.49: three matte warm-white ceramic jars, light bamboo lids, tall to short left to right, the tallest a third of the niche height.
j. TEA TOWEL over the oven bar, x 0.78-0.80: one beige cotton waffle towel, hanging straight.
k. KITCHEN RUNNER before the counter: 60 x 280 ivory wool, low pile, thin line border.

5. NOT IN FRAME: herb pots, step stool, wall lamp, sink set, utensil jar, boards, plants, other food, appliances, books, glass, labels, text, people. No sun patches, beams, bloom, haze, halos, HDR, grain or vignette.
prompt_deviation: lines starting with # stripped as the header instructs; the x / y positions (14 groups) converted from the 16:9 frame to the overscan canvas 4072x2290 (frame = centre crop 3840x2160): x' = 0.0285 + 0.9430 x, y' = 0.0284 + 0.9432 y, 2 decimals

exposure.flag: DARK: needs more than +0.2 stop, not lifted further

grade.rule: docs/render-recipe-nordic-2026-10-24.md 2.6 (the Bible grade): WB on the hero-wall patch, exposure capped +-0.2 stop, chroma -10%, roll-off from L 94, S curve 0.12, black point to L 12.5 only if below 12, no grain, no vignette

image_refs_source: assets/renders/house-nordic-v7-2026-11-02/refs/index-v7.json frames[D2] (the order of the prompt header)

overscan.motion_agent: -graded-os6.png = the 16:9 frame plus 0.0303 of its height above and below (--a-overscan / --b-overscan)

clay_lock.method: regions = whole frame, quadrants, ceiling/floor bands and the clay boxes of fixed furniture / windows / openings; peaks below ~0.03 are unreliable (weak texture), so the verdict is visual (<aid>-lock.png) with the strong-peak number as support

verdict.visual: HELD: counter top, shelves, hood, niche, tall units and floor joints on the clay lines (the Phase B 0.02-0.03 offset is gone)

product_check.rule: each product inside its clay box +-15 % of the box size (<aid>-boxes.png); read visually

self_check_verdict: accepted: lock held, nothing invented; the print, plates, mugs and bowl match D1 v7; mills and jars in their boxes
